implementation.name: original-v1-fetching-optimized
implementation.scope: Canonical illustrative minute axis and exact source stage durations; readiness and consumption are distinct.
implementation.question: Which ready batch keeps the training stage busy?

purpose: Show ready-batch handoff and overlapping independent host/GPU work in the actual Gantt figure.
storyboard: Complete the open before its reads.
Make B1 ready before Train 1 consumes it.
Prepare B2 while B1 trains; retain B2 until Train 2 is ready.
Prepare B3 while B2 trains, then consume and finish B3.
guard: No same-batch read/train dependency is violated. Bars retain canonical durations; movement pace is pedagogical, not measured.
